cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Secrets Have Value
cards.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll name the coworker who reported your lateness if you name whoever reported mine. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then I'll trade departments. Names cost names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Payroll. But I can introduce you to my source.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Marketing. And I'll arrange coffee with mine. Same access, same price.

mechanism: A dictates an equal-value information exchange but adjusts its unit to keep the partner able and willing to trade.
confusable: Unlike generic secrecy or demanding confession first, every offered value is met by a matched type of access.
comparison: Coworker sources and introductions differ from siblings trading equally punishable secrets.
seedUse: D142-a departments and source introductions already supply negotiated adjustment; S02-a contributes confident rule ownership without copied props.
